_note: Pre-duel lead-ins (AdventureLeadIns). Edit freely. Every spoken line is "Speaker: text", where Speaker is a short name from `names`. A scene is {narration, lines}. `pairs` is main character -> opponent character -> slot. Slots, in the order they are tried: boss_again (a boss node, and the main lost the last duel against them), boss (any boss node), after_loss (lost the last duel against them), level (main's personality level at least level_min), act3 (act 3), again (met before), first. A slot can be a list of variants; the first whose conditions hold is used. Variant conditions: deck (the opponent's deck family), met (true: met before, false: never met). A lead-in already shown this run is skipped when a later slot fits. With no pair entry, the opponent's `calls` entry plays and the main answers with a `replies` line whose fits holds the call's kind or "any".

first.narration: Edric meets his wife Alder for the first time since he left for the Heart without telling her.
lines: Alder: Edric Rooke! You went after the Heart without one word to me!
Edric: I left a note!
Alder: For Wren! Shield up, you coward!

again.narration: Alder again. She hasn't forgiven him, and she's brought the whole coven to watch.
lines: Alder: Again, Edric! And keep your left side up this time!
Edric: Yes, dear.

after_loss.narration: Alder beat her husband last time, and the coven hasn't stopped talking about it.
lines: Edric: Go easy on me this time, Alder.
Alder: Not a chance, old man!

act3.narration: Close to the Heart, Alder makes one last try at taking her husband home.
lines: Alder: Come home, Edric! Quarr isn't worth dying for!
Edric: It isn't Quarr I'm doing this for.

level.narration: Alder has noticed Edric fighting more and more like the brother he left behind.
lines: Alder: You fight like a Hask now! Is that Torvan's doing?
Edric: I haven't seen Torvan in years!
Alder: Then why is he writing to you?!

first.narration: Emrys, Edric's eldest son, has come looking for a fight to prove himself to his father.
lines: Emrys: Father! Caedan says you drop your left shoulder!
Edric: Does he, now?

again.narration: Emrys again. The grey metal on his arms has spread since last time.
lines: Emrys: Look, Father! It's growing!
Edric: So I see. Does your mother know?

after_loss.narration: Emrys beat his father last time and is trying very hard not to gloat.
lines: Emrys: I won't go easy on you, Father!
Edric: You never do, son.

boss.narration: Emrys blocks the crossing. If he wins, he comes along. If Edric wins, Emrys goes home.
lines: Emrys: Father! Take me with you, or go through me!
Edric: Emrys, go home. Your mother will skin us both.
Emrys: Then she can skin me after I win!

boss_again.narration: Emrys blocks the crossing again. He isn't giving up.
lines: Emrys: You come back worse every time! Let me help!
Edric: ...Fine. Show me you can.

first.narration: Caedan Vale fought beside Edric in the war and taught him the sword. Caedan's son lives with Edric.
lines: Caedan: Rooke. How's my boy?
Edric: Taller than me! He misses you, Caedan.
Caedan: ...Guard.

again.narration: Caedan again. He's never been one for small talk.
lines: Caedan: Guard, Edric!
Edric: Tavin asked after you, Vale.
Caedan: ...Guard!

after_loss.narration: Caedan won last time, and he still has notes.
lines: Caedan: Left shoulder! Still!
Edric: You've been saying that since the war!

boss.narration: Caedan stands between Edric and the Heart. He wants to see what his old student has become.
lines: Caedan: Show me what you did with my sword, Rooke!
Edric: Everything I could, old friend!

boss_again.narration: Caedan blocks the road again, with a fresh burn on his arm.
lines: Edric: Caedan, you're hurt!
Caedan: Something burning came through ahead of you. Be faster than me, Rooke!

first.narration: Gideon Mourne is a disgraced lord who hates knights that kneel. Edric is one.
lines: Mourne: Well, well! Sir Kneels-a-Lot!
Edric: Stop calling me that, Mourne.
Mourne: LORD Mourne!

again.narration: Mourne is after the Heart like everyone else, and already looking for a buyer.
lines: Mourne: Does the Vigil pay you yet, Rooke? No? Ha!
Edric: Not everything's for sale, Mourne.

after_loss.narration: Mourne won last time and told everyone he met.
lines: Mourne: Back for more, Sir Kneels-a-Lot?
Edric: They say you sleep well these days. How?
Mourne: Like a lord! Now draw!

act3.narration: Close to the Heart, Mourne offers Edric a deal. They fought in the same war once.
lines: Mourne: Help me take it off Quarr, Rooke! For old times' sake!
Edric: We were never on the same side, Mourne.

level.narration: Mourne has been digging into Edric's family.
lines: Mourne: Your brother's Pact, isn't he? Torvan Hask!
Edric: Leave my brother out of this!

first.narration: Bram Ashmark is burning his way toward the Heart. Edric has come to stop him.
lines: Edric: Stop this, boy! Those were people's homes!
Ashmark: ...They were warm.

again.narration: Ashmark again, thinner and hungrier than before.
lines: Edric: Ashmark! You were someone's son once!
Ashmark: Hungry...

after_loss.narration: Ashmark beat the realm's hero last time. All he remembers is being hungry afterwards.
lines: Edric: Nothing fills you, does it?
Ashmark: You might.

act3.narration: Ashmark is close to the Heart now, and the leylines around it are going dark.
lines: Ashmark: The gold one... behind the wall... I can smell it!
Edric: Whatever's back there, it won't fill you either!

level.narration: Edric has been asking about Ashmark in the villages he burned.
lines: Edric: There was a boy who sang on the old road. Was that you?
Ashmark: SHUT UP!

boss.narration: Halden Quarr wears the Lodestone Heart and guards it from everyone. Edric wants it locked away.
lines: Edric: Give me the Heart, Quarr! It belongs in a vault!
Quarr: Vaults get opened. Go home, Rooke.

boss_again.narration: Quarr beat Edric last time. He hasn't moved since.
lines: Edric: Where did you even find that thing?!
Quarr: Go home.

first.narration: Quarr, a long way from his post, with the Heart still on him.
lines: Edric: Quarr?! Out here?
Quarr: Move.

first.narration: Marrow's crew salvages old battlefields. Some of Marrow was once a construct in Mourne's company.
lines: Marrow: My lord! Some of me marched under your crest!
Mourne: Then salute me, scrap heap!
Marrow: Some of me wants to bite!

again.narration: Marrow again. A name is stamped under her jaw, and she can't read it.
lines: Marrow: My lord... whose name is under my jaw?
Mourne: How should I know?!
Marrow: Some of me thinks you do.

after_loss.narration: Marrow won last time and kept a piece of Mourne's armour as a trophy.
lines: Mourne: Give that back, you walking junk pile!
Marrow: Some of me likes it here.

boss.narration: Marrow wants Mourne's help taking the Heart, but they can't agree on his price.
lines: Marrow: Name your price, my lord!
Mourne: More than all of you put together!
Marrow: Then we take it out of you!

boss_again.narration: Marrow again. Kell watches from the edge of the field.
lines: Marrow: Beat me, and some of me will follow you again!
Mourne: Only some?!

first.narration: Sable Draik, captain of the Draik Company, wants Mourne in her crew.
lines: Sable: Gideon Mourne! Just the man I wanted!
Mourne: That's LORD Mourne to you, pirate!

again.narration: Sable again, carrying a company coat in Mourne's size.
lines: Sable: Try it on, Gideon! Just once!
Mourne: I'd sooner die!

after_loss.narration: Sable beat him last time, and she still wants him.
lines: Mourne: Why me, Sable?!
Sable: Nobody can make you kneel. I like that!

boss.narration: Sable's last offer: join the Draik Company, or be her partner in the Heart.
lines: Sable: Last chance, Gideon! The coat, or half the Heart!
Mourne: LORD Mourne!
Sable: Not on my ship, darling!

boss.narration: The Draik captain has heard about a disgraced lord on the Heart's road, and she wants him.
lines: Sable: You! Win, and you're crew. Lose, and you're cargo!
Mourne: I'm nobody's cargo!

boss_again.narration: Sable again, the coat still over her arm.
lines: Sable: It's still your size, Gideon!
Mourne: Put that thing away!

first.narration: Sir Edric Rooke, the realm's hero, kneels to the Vigil. Mourne hates him for it.
lines: Mourne: Sir Kneels-a-Lot! What a treat!
Edric: Mourne. Still no title, I see.
Mourne: LORD Mourne, you old dog!
Edric: They say you sleep well these days, Mourne.
Mourne: Every night! Jealous, Rooke?

after_loss.narration: Edric won last time. Mourne hasn't forgiven him. Mourne forgives nobody.
lines: Mourne: You got lucky, Rooke!
Edric: I got up, Mourne. Try it sometime.

act3.narration: Edric has fire in his hands now. Mourne knows the look of a man who paid for his power.
lines: Mourne: Who's holding your leash, Rooke?!
Edric: Nobody! It's mine!
Mourne: Hah! That's what I said!

act3.narration: Close to the Heart, Mourne wants to know who Edric kneels to now.
lines: Mourne: Both kings are dead, Rooke! Who do you kneel to now?!
Edric: Whoever stands between the gate and the village!

level.narration: Mourne has been asking about Edric's brother, Torvan Hask.
lines: Mourne: Your brother's Pact, Rooke! Runs in the family?
Edric: Leave Torvan out of this!

first.narration: Mourne and Ashmark both carry a demon's mark from the same toll gate.
lines: Mourne: So you've got his mark too, boy!
Ashmark: Hungry...
Mourne: Yes, yes, I can see that!

again.narration: Ashmark again. He burned down a farm to find Mourne.
lines: Mourne: It took my claim. What did it take from you?
Ashmark: ...Everything.

after_loss.narration: Ashmark won last time. Mourne thinks he can use him anyway.
lines: Mourne: Work for me, boy! I'll point, you eat!
Ashmark: I'll eat you.

act3.narration: Both are close to the Heart. Mourne wants to sell it. Ashmark wants to eat what's behind it.
lines: Mourne: Leave something for me to sell, boy!
Ashmark: No.

level.narration: Mourne wonders what the man at the toll gate asked Ashmark.
lines: Mourne: What did he ask you first, at the gate? He asked me my name!
Ashmark: ...What I wanted.
Mourne: And you told him?! Fool!

boss.narration: Quarr guards the Heart. Mourne wants to buy it, or take it.
lines: Mourne: Name your price, Quarr! Everyone has one!
Quarr: Not for sale.

boss_again.narration: Quarr beat Mourne last time. Mourne has brought a better offer.
lines: Mourne: Half of what it's worth! Final offer!
Quarr: No.

first.narration: Quarr, a long way from his post, with the Heart still on him.
lines: Mourne: You look tired, Quarr! Let me carry it!
Quarr: Keep walking.

first.narration: Siphon has been rebuilt with new wards. It's still hungry.
lines: Siphon: New wards. They itch. You have charge?
Ashmark: No.
Siphon: Liar. You are warm!

first.narration: Siphon, a runaway construct, drinks from the leylines. Ashmark burns the same ones.
lines: Siphon: You are burning my leyline!
Ashmark: Then take it back.

again.narration: Siphon again, standing on a leyline Ashmark has already drained.
lines: Siphon: This one was mine! You left only ash!
Ashmark: More...

after_loss.narration: Siphon won last time, and drank some of Ashmark's fire.
lines: Siphon: You were delicious. Thank you.
Ashmark: Give it BACK!

boss.narration: Siphon has drained three leylines since it escaped the Collegium. It wants Ashmark's fire next.
lines: Siphon: So much charge in you! Give it to me!
Ashmark: Mine!

boss_again.narration: Siphon is starving now, and has stopped being polite.
lines: Siphon: Give! GIVE IT!
Ashmark: Now you understand.

first.narration: Sir Edric Rooke, the realm's hero, stands between Ashmark and the next town.
lines: Edric: Turn back, Ashmark!
Ashmark: To what?

again.narration: The hero again. His coven has flooded the road to stop the fire.
lines: Edric: There's still a man in there! I know it!
Ashmark: Look closer.

after_loss.narration: Edric beat Ashmark last time. Ashmark has been hungry about it ever since.
lines: Ashmark: Again!
Edric: As many times as it takes!

boss.narration: Edric has found a fire of his own. Ashmark can smell it.
lines: Ashmark: You burn now, hero!
Edric: Not like you!
Ashmark: Not yet...

boss_again.narration: The fire has spread up Edric's arms since last time.
lines: Ashmark: Does it want more yet, hero?
Edric: ...Every day.

first.narration: Gideon Mourne went to the same toll gate as Ashmark, years before him.
lines: Mourne: Same mark, boy! Mine's just better behaved!
Ashmark: Yours is quiet.

again.narration: Mourne again, with a proposal. He always has a proposal.
lines: Mourne: Let's work together, boy! I know every road!
Ashmark: Fuel.

after_loss.narration: Mourne won last time and told the whole county.
lines: Mourne: Heel, boy!
Ashmark: No.

act3.narration: Close to the Heart, Mourne tries to strike a deal.
lines: Mourne: Give me the Heart, and you can eat whatever's behind the wall!
Ashmark: You first.

boss.narration: Quarr guards the Heart. Ashmark wants the Eidolons behind the wall, to eat them.
lines: Quarr: Turn back, lad. Nothing back there will fill you.
Ashmark: Liar!

boss_again.narration: Quarr beat Ashmark last time. Both of them are still bleeding.
lines: Ashmark: The pale one... the moths... she's hungry too...
Quarr: Then she'll eat you first.

first.narration: Quarr, away from his post. Ashmark can smell the Heart on him.
lines: Ashmark: I smell it on you!
Quarr: Walk away, lad.

_joined_note: A personality that joined the run deck (Emrys for Edric, Kell for Mourne) adds one line after the exchange, at most once per act. Keys: `once` (the first duel after joining), an opponent character, `construct` (an opponent tagged construct), then `any`.

Emrys Rooke.Gideon Mourne: Emrys: Is that the lord Mother warned me about?
Emrys Rooke.Bram Ashmark: Emrys: Father... he's looking at me like I'm food!
Emrys Rooke.construct: Emrys: Does it feel it when you hit it?

Orvath Kell.once: Kell: I still wear the gorget, my lord. Someone has to.
Orvath Kell.Marrow: Kell: Those rivets... those were ours!

_whispers_note: Ashmark takes something from each person he beats. In later lead-ins that run, one of them can speak as a third line: `from` is keyed by the beaten character, `own` plays when no beaten voice is left. Each whisper plays once a run. `answer` sometimes follows.

from.Siphon: The leash was warm... why did we break it...
from.Gideon Mourne: Nobody left to pay me... nobody...
from.Sable Draik: Keep the man... sell the coat...
from.Emrys Rooke: Father will come. He always comes.

own: So many carts in the yard... all waiting...
Mother left bread by the fire...
You could stop. You could just... stop.

Sable Draik.narration: Sable Draik, captain of a mercenary crew, buys up debts. She thinks you owe somebody.
Sable Draik.line: Sable: Everyone on this road owes someone! Pay up!

Osric Thornwald.narration: Osric Thornwald, an old druid of the grove, sits reading in the middle of the road.
Osric Thornwald.line: Osric: Hm? Did the grove send you?

Siphon.narration: Siphon, a runaway construct, is starving. It can smell the mana on you.
Siphon.line: Siphon: You have charge! Give it!

Marrow.narration: Marrow, a construct built out of scrap, is always looking for parts.
Marrow.line: Marrow: Good joints! Some of me wants them!

Dame Alder Rooke.narration: Dame Alder Rooke, matriarch of the coven, guards the roads her family travels.
Dame Alder Rooke.line: Alder: Turn back! My family's on this road!

Emrys Rooke.narration: Emrys Rooke, a young knight's son, wants practice against strangers.

Caedan Vale.narration: Caedan Vale, the last Vale swordsman, is blocking the road.

_replies_note: fits: the call kinds a reply answers (challenge, demand, warning, question, any). `construct`: only against a construct. level_min: the main's personality level needed; a reply that has one is preferred once it is reached.

Sir Edric Rooke.line: Edric: I'd feed you if I could...
Edric: Edric Rooke. Just passing through!
Edric: You fight like my brother. That's not a compliment.
Edric: Caedan taught me better than this!

Gideon Mourne.line: Mourne: LORD Mourne, if you please!
Mourne: Nobody's paying you for this, you know!
Mourne: Everything's for sale. You can't afford it!
Mourne: Kings have warned me. Look where they are now!
Mourne: I've paid worse tolls than you!
Mourne: I had a whole company once. You'd never have made the front rank.
